cost: O(B^2) conservative for repeated plain link suffix scans and label rescans; O(B) text/char buffers; output one row and gloss truncated160 Unicode chars plus ellipsis.
description: Line XML reader unescapes title/text and dispatches namespace0 to emit. emit selects English slice via first newline heading heuristic, first eligible POS/gloss and deduplicated register/region senses; title and multiword gates precede six-column TSV and kind precedence.
forward: Line XML reader unescapes title/text and dispatches namespace0 to emit. emit selects English slice via first newline heading heuristic, first eligible POS/gloss and deduplicated register/region senses; title and multiword gates precede six-column TSV and kind precedence.
inverse: Colon namespace/long title/no English/no POS exclude output. An unlabeled single word excludes output even with valid gloss.
TSV row admits many discarded templates, alternate labels, later senses and non-English sections; first POS/gloss projection loses source uniquely.
limitations: UTF-8 wikitext, line-based export shape. Plain text is heuristic, not complete wiki parser. English boundary deeper-heading limitation and title TSV sanitation gaps remain.
Partial syntax and bounded synthetic helper checks; no command/corpus/model/download effects, universal proof or percentage surrogate.
state: At most one row per emit; first POS and first labeled sense retained. Title>60 chars or colon rejects. Single word needs register/variety; all accepted multiwords receive a kind even without idiomatic label.
